      • checkAccess

        public static String checkAccess(String systemId,
                                 String allowedProtocols,
                                 String accessAny)
                          throws IOException
        Check the protocol used in the systemId against allowed protocols
        参数:
        systemId - the Id of the URI
        allowedProtocols - a list of allowed protocols separated by comma
        accessAny - keyword to indicate allowing any protocol
        返回:
        the name of the protocol if rejected, null otherwise

        IOException
